product.name: Marriott Bonvoy Business American Express Card

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.estimate_basis: Award redeemable at hotels costing up to 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, valued at 0.8 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. This is the award ceiling, not a typical redemption — record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points
benefits.notes: Issued each year after the card renewal month. A second award is earned after $60,000 of purchases in a calendar year; that one is not tracked because it is conditional on spend.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary Gold Elite status while the card is open. No dollar value is tracked.
